A separate, earlier fixed-view room 129 save was copied to pilot manual slot 4, loaded through the UI, and quicksaved to pilot quick slot 3 before firing. This did not recreate the reporter's manual route, original missile aim, or issue save.

save_load_repeat: The launcher listed the separate quicksave as [quick] level 2 and Load Last Save restored the same panel, score 600, shields 79 and Concussion 6. The immediate repeat changed Concussion 6 to 5, close blast reduced shields to 49, touch steering shifted the panel, and the app stayed open.
